About

I build things that move, sense and think. I'm a mechanical engineer working at the intersection of robotics, automation and intelligent manufacturing, where mechanical design meets control, sensing and autonomy.

I'm currently on my placement year at Harwin as a Software Engineering Intern in the production support team, troubleshooting and optimising the robots that support production of Harwin products. Day to day that means adjusting Keyence camera settings, PLC code and HMI screens.

Before that, I led a 30-person team building a programmable Mars rover. I've written an RRT path planner for a nonholonomic robot, modelled ECU-based ABS control in Simulink, and turned solid-mechanics theory into a validated MATLAB tool that scored 100%. I care about designs that survive contact with reality, so I build, test, refine, and document what breaks.
